Donaustadt (22. Bezirk) — Vienna, Austria

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Donaustadt is Vienna's largest district by area, dominated by the Donauinsel recreation strip, Kagran/Stadlau housing areas and UNO City, and press coverage found no particular daytime safety concern for visitors to these areas. Between January and April 2024, a gang of Austrian teenagers (14-17) carried out 45 forced break-ins at shops, bakeries and pizzerias in the Stadlau/Neu-Kagran area before being caught (vienna.at, 2024) — a property-crime pattern rather than a threat to travellers. On the Donauinsel itself, incidents are occasional and quickly resolved: in August 2026 a 30-year-old was threatened with a knife and had his e-scooter stolen late at night, with the suspect arrested nearby within a short time (meinbezirk.at, Aug 2026). The annual Donauinselfest draws a large security operation (hundreds of officers, 297 reports and 17 arrests over three days in 2025), which police called a largely orderly, safe event (ORF, Jun 2025). Sources checked: vienna.at, "Teenie-Bande in Wien-Donaustadt nach Einbruchsserie geschnappt" (2024); meinbezirk.at, "Nach Messer-Überfall auf Donauinsel schnappt Polizei Täter schnell" (22 Aug 2026); wien.ORF.at, "Donauinselfest: 17 Festnahmen, 297 Anzeigen" (23 Jun 2025).
